comment: Rates, for sentences run more than once. The table in docs/auto-invocation.md is one session per row, which says what happened once and not how often. When a sentence starts behaving unevenly, ./scripts/measure_invocation.py --only TEXT -n N --record adds it here. Written by that script; the prose that cites it is generated from these numbers. Rows measured before 10 November 2026 were run when the prompts had one- and two-letter names (/d for /debug-failure); the keys were renamed with the folders.
